name: Depth-First Search
description: Graph traversal that explores as far as possible along each branch before backtracking. Uses a stack (explicit or call stack via recursion).
aim: Traverse or search a graph by exploring each branch fully before trying the next. Essential for cycle detection, topological sort, path finding, and SCC algorithms.
howItWorks: Mark start node as visited, push to stack
Push all unvisited neighbors onto the stack

time.bestCase: Always must visit all reachable vertices and edges

complexity.spaceDescription: Stack and visited array — O(V) in worst case for a path graph

realWorld: Topological sort in build systems (Makefile, webpack)
Solving puzzles with unique solutions (mazes, sudoku)
alternatives: BFS — finds shortest path in unweighted graphs
Dijkstra — shortest path in weighted graphs
A* — when heuristic available for guided search
